/en/advanced-techniques-for-managing-def.html:
Managing deformations is one of the main challenges in the modern construction industry. Building structures are subjected to dynamic and static stresses that, if not properly monitored and controlled, can compromise their integrity and safety. In this article, we explore advanced techniques that allow for anticipating, controlling, and correcting such deformations, ensuring optimal and long-lasting performance over time.

One of the most effective methods involves using smart materials, such as fiber-reinforced composites, which, thanks to their adaptive and resistant properties, help absorb and evenly distribute stresses. Additionally, integrating sensors within structures enables real-time monitoring, facilitating timely and targeted interventions.

At the same time, advanced numerical modeling methodologies supported by artificial intelligence enable highly accurate predictions of structural deformation behaviors under various load conditions. This predictive approach allows for more efficient design and more precise maintenance planning.

Finally, localized reinforcement techniques—such as applying high-strength tie rods or injecting expanding materials at critical points—are essential solutions for structural recovery, enhancing load-bearing capacity and overall safety of the building.

By combining these strategies, construction professionals can effectively address deformation-related issues, thereby contributing to building safer, higher-performing, and longer-lasting structures.

Luxury Kitchens: Where Exclusive Design Meets the Heart of the Home

The kitchen is no longer just a service area. In recent years, it has transformed, evolving into the true stage of domestic life. It’s the space where functionality embraces aesthetics, where aromas blend with conversations, and where design becomes a daily experience.

At Marenetto Build, we believe a luxury kitchen should not only "look" beautiful but also "feel" perfect. That’s why we combine the mastery of Italian craftsmanship with the most modern architectural visions to create spaces that are literally the beating heart of your home.

Beyond Function: A Living Work of Art

What sets apart a standard kitchen from a luxury kitchen designed by Marenetto Build? The answer lies in one word: exclusivity.

We don’t believe in standardized solutions. Every project starts from a blank canvas and listening closely to your needs. A luxury kitchen is a tailored garment, custom-made for the spaces it occupies and the people who live in it.

  • Architectural volumes: Sculptural central islands that serve as convivial totems.

  • Visual continuity: Solutions that seamlessly integrate with the living area, breaking down barriers between food preparation and relaxation.

The Excellence of Italian Craftsmanship

True luxury is tactile. It resides in the touch of a polished marble countertop, in the warmth of hand-treated solid wood, in the silent solidity of a flawless closing mechanism.

Choosing Marenetto Build means accessing a selection of precious materials that celebrate Italian "Know-How":

A style note: True luxury doesn’t shout; it whispers. It’s the obsessive care for invisible details that makes the difference between a good kitchen and a masterpiece.

Invisible Technology Serving Comfort

For Marenetto Build, designing your kitchen means crafting the setting for your future memories. Whether you love contemporary minimalist style or a reinterpreted classic look, our goal is to create a space that truly represents you.

Don’t settle for ordinary. Let yourself be inspired by Italian craftsmanship and exclusive design.

/en/zen-pools-and-ponds.html:
Water Oases: Infinity Pools and Zen Ponds for Your Personal Paradise

Water is the primordial element of well-being. It has the power to instantly transform a garden's atmosphere, bringing calm, shimmering reflections, and a timeless sense of luxury.

At Marenetto Build, creating pools and ponds isn’t just construction—it’s landscape architecture. Whether it’s a modern infinity pool embracing the horizon or a zen pond designed to restore inner balance, our goal is to craft true water oases perfectly harmonized with the surrounding nature.

Infinity Pools: The Aesthetics of Infinity

For those seeking maximum visual impact and contemporary design, the infinity pool (or vanishing edge pool) is the ideal choice.

This architectural solution removes the visual boundary between water and environment. Water elegantly overflows along one or more edges, creating a mirror effect that seems to blend with the sky or garden panorama.

Why choose an infinity pool crafted by Marenetto Build:

  • Visual Continuity: Perfect for sloped terrains or panoramic views, it extends your gaze towards infinity.

  • Crisp Lines: No raised edges interrupt the design harmony; water becomes a crystal-clear sheet embedded in greenery.

  • Water Purity: The continuous recirculation system ensures always crystal-clear water and superior surface cleanliness.

Zen Ponds: Nature as Architect

If your ideal relaxation is the rustling of leaves and the gentle movement of water among stones, then a Zen Pond is your answer.

Inspired by Eastern philosophy but built with modern technologies, these water mirrors are designed to appear as spontaneous works of nature. They are not mere basins but ecosystems of beauty where natural rocks, gravel, and aquatic plants coexist in harmony.

The expert’s advice: A zen pond is not just decorative. It can become a place for meditation, a focal point inviting calm and slowing down life’s hectic pace.

Maximum Landscape Integration

The hallmark of Marenetto Build lies in our ability to read the land. We don’t "impose" a structure on your garden; we let it emerge from within it.

The landscape integration is at the core of our approach:

  1. Material Study: We use local stones, water-resistant woods (such as Teak or Ipe for sun decks), and finishes that evoke earth and rock tones.

  2. Respect for Topography: We exploit natural slopes to create dramatic waterfalls or overflow edges, minimizing environmental impact from excavation.

  3. Green Design: Water is never alone. We design surrounding vegetation so it embraces the pool or pond, ensuring privacy and full immersion in nature.

The Value of Relaxation

Adding a water feature to your property isn’t just an aesthetic choice; it’s an investment in your quality of life. Imagine coming home to take a sunset swim in your infinity pool or reading a book soothed by the sounds of your private pond.

At Marenetto Build, we turn this vision into solid reality, backed by impeccable technical execution that lasts through time.

Dreaming of a private oasis in your garden?

From the precise geometry of a luxury pool to the natural poetry of an ornamental pond, we’re ready to design custom water features just for you.

Contact Marenetto Build for an inspection visit. Let us elevate your relaxation experience.

/en/stamped-resin-flooring.html:
Stamped Resin Floors: The Art of Walking on Design

The floor is much more than just a surface to walk on; it’s the canvas where your home’s style is painted. If traditional tiles feel like an obvious choice and you’re looking for something that combines industrial durability with artistic aesthetics, stamped resin floors are the ultimate answer.

At Marenetto Build, we have embraced this technology because it allows us to offer our clients something truly unique: seamless surfaces, customizable down to the millimeter, capable of completely transforming how space is perceived.

A Style Revolution: Interiors and Exteriors

One of the greatest advantages of our stamped resin systems is their versatility. Forget visual breaks. Imagine a floor that flows seamlessly from your living room to the poolside, creating an unparalleled sense of spaciousness and architectural continuity.

  • For Interiors: We craft warm, inviting surfaces without joints (making them hygienic and very easy to clean) that can replicate the elegance of natural stone, aged wood, or contemporary minimalist textures.

  • For Exteriors: This is where the technology shines. Our stamped floors resist UV rays, frost, and wear, preserving their beauty over time. They’re the perfect solution for driveways, patios, and pool areas thanks to customizable anti-slip properties.

Artistic Finishes: Every Floor Is a Unique Masterpiece

Why do we talk about "craftsmanship"? Because a stamped resin floor isn’t simply laid down: it’s created.

Unlike prefabricated materials, resin is worked on-site by our master installers. This means that:

  1. Custom Textures: Using professional molds and manual techniques, we can faithfully reproduce marble veins, slate roughness, or porphyry patterns—but with superior durability.

  2. Bespoke Colors: You’re not limited to a catalog. We can create gradients, cloud effects, or solid colors perfectly matched to your furniture or home’s exterior color.

The Marenetto Build touch: We don’t just apply material. We study light and environment to recommend the finish that best enhances your home’s volumes.

Beauty That Lasts Over Time

Design should never sacrifice functionality. Choosing a stamped resin floor means investing in an extremely durable solution.

This is a monolithic surface—meaning there are no individual tiles that can crack or sink separately. It resists impacts, stains, and heavy foot traffic. It perfectly blends the robustness of concrete with the refinement of decorative resin.

Transform Your Spaces

Whether renovating an old existing floor (often without demolition thanks to its low thickness) or designing a new home, stamped resin solutions offer absolute creative freedom.

With Marenetto Build, your floor becomes the centerpiece. Let yourself be amazed by surfaces that furnish, inspire emotion, and withstand everyday life.

Want to experience the difference firsthand?

Don’t just imagine your new floor: let’s design it together. Contact Marenetto Build to discover our range of textures and artistic finishes.

/en/stone-works-and-facades.html:
🗿 Stone Works and Facades: The Art of Dressing Architecture with Iconic Materials

In the world of luxury construction and renovation, a building's facade is not just an envelope but its identity card and interface with the outside world. At MarenettoBuild, we believe true architectural excellence shines through the expert use of noble materials and the priceless value of artisan craftsmanship.

Our focus on Stone Works and Facades is rooted in deep admiration for building traditions, combined with a forward-looking approach to contemporary, lasting design solutions.

💎 Stone: A Symbol of Durability and Prestige

Natural stone has always been the preferred material to impart prestige, character, and resilience to exteriors. From historic villas to high-end modern properties, using stone is never a trivial choice.

Through careful selection of materials ranging from local calcarenites such as Trani or Apricena Stone, to internationally prized marbles and granites, MarenettoBuild guarantees:

  • Unmatched Longevity: Stone withstands weathering, wear, and time exceptionally well.

  • Natural Insulation: It enhances the thermal and acoustic comfort of the building.

  • Unique Aesthetic: Every block and slab is one-of-a-kind, giving the facade an exclusive look with strong visual impact.

🛠️ Excellence in Artisan Craftsmanship

A premium material demands premium workmanship. Our craftsmen inherit ancient knowledge, capable of transforming raw stone into .

Our stone works for facades include:

  1. Bush-hammered and Sawn Finishes: To create textures that play with light, from rustic to minimalist styles.

  2. Moldings, Capitals, and Shaped Balconies: Details that define a property's style, custom made.

  3. Bases and Plinths: Essential protections for the facade often crafted from stones more resistant to moisture and abrasion.

  4. Engravings and Bas-reliefs: Unique customizations that tell a story and enhance the facade’s character.

Thanks to meticulous work in manual installation and grouting, we ensure not only stunning aesthetics but also perfect structural integrity and water resistance.

🌍 Enhancing Local Materials

Selecting local materials like renowned Apulian stones isn’t just a choice for sustainability (reducing environmental impact related to transport), but also a tribute to the architectural heritage of the region.

Using zero-kilometer materials ensures the new facade harmoniously blends into its landscape and urban context, giving your property a sense of belonging and authenticity that industrial materials cannot replicate. This approach enhances heritage value while guaranteeing an investment that holds its worth over time.

Renovate Without Demolition: The Complete Guide to Microverlay® Microcement by Isoplam

Home renovation is often seen as a logistical nightmare: deafening noise, dust everywhere, debris disposal, and extended construction times. Many homeowners give up on modernizing their spaces just to avoid the stress of demolition. Moreover, in historic centers like Cefalù, debris removal and site access become a real challenge!

But what if we told you there’s a way to completely transform your floors and coverings without removing a single tile?

We at Marenetto Build, as certified partners and applicators, want to introduce you to the solution that has revolutionized modern interior design: Isoplam’s Microverlay® Microcement.

What Exactly Is Microverlay®?

Often mistaken for common "resins," Microverlay is technically a decorative coating made from cementitious and polymer-based materials. Its strength lies in an engineering paradox: it has an imperceptible thickness (only 3 millimeters) yet boasts extraordinary mechanical and wear resistance.

Unlike pure epoxy resins that can yellow or scratch easily, Isoplam’s cement base gives the material a natural, textured look with superior durability. It’s the preferred choice for architects and designers who want seamless surfaces—meaning no grout lines.

Where Can We Apply It?

The versatility of Microverlay is nearly limitless. As experienced applicators, we at Marenetto Build have worked on:

  • Existing Floors: Tiles, marble, mosaic, sand-cement screeds.
  • Vertical Walls: Drywall or plaster.
  • Furniture Elements: Kitchen countertops, tables, bathroom cabinets.
  • Damp Areas: Inside showers, bathtubs, kitchen backsplashes.

The Application Process: The Importance of Isoplam Certification

Many think microcement is a "DIY" product. Nothing could be further from the truth. Applying Microverlay is a complex artisanal process requiring chemical precision and artistic skill.

Being Isoplam certified means strictly following the official application cycle to ensure the floor neither cracks nor peels over time. Here’s how we work:

  1. Surface Preparation: This is the most critical phase. The old floor is sanded and cleaned. If tiles are present, we apply a specific primer and possibly fiberglass mesh to even out the surface and prevent underlying grout lines from "rising" to the surface (the so-called ghosting effect).
  2. Base Application: We spread the first coat of Microverlay Base or Medium, which provides body and strength to the structure.
  3. Decorative Finish: This is where artistry comes into play. We apply Microverlay Finish with a trowel. Depending on hand movement, we can create cloud-like effects, more textured looks, or smooth minimalist finishes.
  4. Sanding: Between coats, the surface is sanded to ensure softness to the touch.
  5. Final Protection: The decisive step. We apply specific protective coatings such as Plam Pol (a polyurethane resin) that makes the floor water-repellent, stain-resistant, and scratch-proof.

Microcement vs Tiles vs Parquet: A Comparison

Indestructible Outdoor Flooring: The Ultimate Guide to Stamped Concrete and Skyconcrete

Designing an outdoor floor means facing a double challenge: aesthetics must impress at first glance, but the technical aspect must withstand extreme conditions. Rain, frost, UV rays, oil stains, and the weight of vehicles put any surface to the test.

As Isoplam certified applicators, we at Marenetto Build offer two leading technologies that go beyond the limits of tiles and natural stone: Stamped Concrete (Plam Stampable) and Low-thickness Nuvolato (Skyconcrete Outdoor).

Which one is right for your project? Let’s analyze them in detail.

1. Plam Stampable: Monolithic Stamped Concrete

The Plam Stampable system is the ideal solution if you need to create flooring from scratch (on soil or gravel) or require very high load-bearing capacity.

This isn’t about laying individual stones but creating a monolithic concrete slab (typically 10-15 cm thick) that is "stamped" and colored while still fresh.

Technical Advantages:

  • Unique Structure: Being a single reinforced concrete block eliminates the risk of settling or shifting common with interlocking pavers or dry-laid stone.
  • No Weeds: There are no real joints, only aesthetic impressions. Grass cannot grow and dirt doesn’t accumulate.
  • Certified Anti-slip: Thanks to the texture imprinted by molds, it ensures high grip levels, achieving safety classes R11, R12, or R13—essential for steep ramps or pool edges.

Installation Steps (The Marenetto Build Method):

  1. Preparation: Laying fiber-reinforced concrete with Plam Fibre additives to increase mechanical strength.
  2. Hardening: Applying colored hardener Plam Hardening, which doubles abrasion resistance compared to regular concrete.
  3. Stamping: Applying release agent Plam Rele and pressing Isoplam rubber molds to create stone, brick, or wood effects.
  4. Finishing: Thorough washing and sealing with protective resin.

2. Skyconcrete Outdoor: Low Thickness Design

If you already have a concrete screed or old tiled flooring and don’t want to demolish it, Skyconcrete Outdoor is the answer.

This is a cementitious coating just 2-4 millimeters thick, transforming dull surfaces into designer floors with a continuous "nuvolato" effect.

Why Choose It:

  • Quick Renovation: Applied directly over existing screeds or tiles (after preparation), avoiding demolition costs.
  • Total Resistance: Resistant to winter de-icing salts, pool chlorine, and UV rays.
  • Smooth Aesthetic: The absence of joints visually expands space, creating a modern “industrial loft” look even in gardens.

Protection and Maintenance: The Secret Is in Sealing

The durability of Isoplam floors is ensured by the final treatments we apply after installation.

We use specific resins like Plam Sealing (available in water-based or solvent versions) that penetrate deep into the pores of the concrete. This treatment makes the surface:

  • Water and Oil Repellent: Protects against accidental spills of motor oil or food.
  • Dust Resistant: Consolidates the surface preventing powdering.
  • Easier to Clean: Just wash with a pressure washer and neutral detergents like Wow Isoplam.

A Direct Comparison: Which Solution Suits You?

Thermal Insulation vs Thermal Plaster: What to Choose for the Sicilian Climate?

A technical analysis of the best insulation solutions to protect your home from summer heat and winter humidity.

When discussing energy retrofitting in Sicily, applying standards designed for Northern Europe can be costly. Our Mediterranean climate poses unique challenges: short humid winters and long scorching summers.

If you are renovating your home with Marenetto Build, you have probably faced the dilemma: is traditional panel insulation or modern thermal plaster better?

Let’s analyze the technical differences focusing on performance in our region.

The Key Factor: Phase Shift and Breathability

Before comparing materials, we need to understand what a house in Sicily requires:

  • Heat Protection (Thermal Phase Shift): In July and August, the insulator must delay heat entry until evening.
  • Humidity Management: In coastal areas, walls must “breathe” to prevent interstitial mold.

1. Thermal Insulation (Panel Insulation)

p>The system involves applying insulating panels (EPS, Rock Wool, Cork) onto the facade. h3>The Advantages ul>
  • Top Winter Insulation: Unmatched low thermal transmittance values.

    • The Limits for Sicily

    • Thickness: Requires 8 to 14 cm thickness (problematic for thresholds).
    • Risk of "Greenhouse Effect": Using cheap EPS may trap summer heat inside.
    The expert advice: For Sicily, prefer Rock Wool or Cork to ensure better summer phase shift.

    2. Thermal Plaster (Thermo-plaster)

    A premixed mortar enriched with lightweight aggregates (perlite, cork, nanotechnologies).

    The Advantages

    • Adaptability: Perfect for historic centers and irregular facades.
    • Excellent Breathability: Ideal for tuff or stone masonry.
    • Heat Reflection: Many modern plasters repel solar radiation.

    The Limits

    At equal thickness, it insulates less than panel insulation. It might require additional measures to reach high energy classes (Superbonus).

Building Safely: Your Ten-Year Warranty on Construction Work

When investing in building or renovating a property, the main concern is rarely the construction site itself, but rather what happens afterward. "What if cracks appear after a few years?" or "What if there are leaks?".

At Marenetto Build, we believe quality is proven over time. That’s why we offer our clients the option to activate a ten-year post-completion insurance policy: solid protection that safeguards your investment for 10 years after the work is completed.

What Is the Ten-Year Post-Completion Insurance Policy?

The ten-year post-completion insurance policy is an essential insurance coverage in the construction industry. Although the Civil Code (art. 1669) already holds contractors responsible for serious defects, having a dedicated insurance policy turns this legal obligation into a definite and payable guarantee.

Simply put: if serious structural issues arise within 10 years after delivery, you won’t have to chase down the builder or face lengthy court battles. There is insurance ready to cover restoration costs.

What Does Marenetto Build’s Ten-Year Guarantee Cover?

Our priority is transparency. The insurance coverage we offer is designed to protect the property from so-called hidden defects or major construction flaws.

Here are the main areas covered:

  • Damage to the load-bearing structure: Issues compromising the building’s stability (foundations, beams, pillars).

  • Waterproofing and roofing: Defects causing water infiltration through roofs or terraces (one of the most common causes of disputes).

  • Total or partial collapse: Severe failures rendering the structure unusable.

  • Damage to third parties: Coverage for damages caused to neighboring properties due to construction defects.

Expert Note: Renovating without a ten-year warranty exposes owners to huge financial risks. With Marenetto Build, those risks are eliminated.

Why Is This a Competitive Advantage for You?

Choosing a construction partner like Marenetto Build, capable of providing this type of insurance means relying on a solid company. Insurance companies issue these policies only after verifying the technical and financial solvency of the contractor.

  1. Property value: A property covered by a ten-year warranty has higher market value and is easier to resell.

  2. Total peace of mind: You know you won’t have to pay out-of-pocket for structural errors not caused by you over 10 years.

  3. Quality control: Activating this policy often requires rigorous technical inspections during construction phases, ensuring higher quality standards.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Is ten-year insurance mandatory for renovations?

For new constructions, it’s legally required (Legislative Decree 122/2005), while for manual renovations, it’s optional but highly recommended. Marenetto Build offers it to provide maximum protection.

How much does activating the warranty cost?

The cost is a variable percentage based on the project value (usually indexed). However, consider it an investment in securing your asset rather than an expense.

What happens if I sell my house before 10 years?

The ten-year policy follows the property, not the owner. If you sell your home, the warranty transfers to the new buyer, significantly increasing your property's market appeal.

You want stress-free renovations?

Don’t leave your home’s future to chance.

Contact Marenetto Build's team today for a free quote and discover how we can secure your project with our ten-year guarantee.

/en/water-and-moisture-leak-detection-ho.html:
Do you have a hidden leak? A moisture stain you can't explain? Often, the problem isn't where the mark appears on the wall but somewhere else. The Assistance and Emergency Service from Marenetto Build was created to solve these technical mysteries without demolishing your home "by trial and error".

We use the most advanced non-destructive investigation technologies to map systems and infiltrations, ensuring real savings in time and restoration costs.

How do we identify the cause? Our technological equipment

We don't just look at the wall. We go inside the structures thanks to an excellent diagnostic kit that covers every possible failure scenario.

1. Infrared Thermography and Thermal Camera

Thermography is our first eye. Thanks to the thermal camera, we detect even slight temperature variations on surfaces. Water-saturated areas have different thermal capacity: this allows us to visualize the "thermal footprint" of moisture behind plaster, screeds, and drywall, precisely identifying the shape of the leak.

2. Geophone: Listening to underground sounds

For leaks in underground water systems or beneath flooring, we use the geophone. This electroacoustic investigation tool amplifies the noise (vibration) generated by pressurized water escaping. It's the ideal solution for locating breaks in water pipes without having to break up the entire floor.

3. Professional Hygrometer

To distinguish between rainwater infiltration, water leakage, or simple condensation, we use the hygrometer. We measure the deep moisture percentage in building materials, essential for properly diagnosing rising dampness or structural thermal bridges.

4. Endoscope and Video Inspection

If suspicion falls on drains or cavities, we use the endoscope (or endoscopic camera). This flexible probe allows visual inspection inside pipes, chimneys, and hollow walls, showing any cracks, blockages, or damaged joints live on a monitor.

When should you request a technical survey?

Our intervention is crucial not only in emergencies but also in various professional contexts:

  • Hidden Leaks: Excessively high water bills without apparent consumption.

  • Terrace Infiltrations: Identifying the exact point of waterproof membrane rupture.

  • Mold and Condensation: Climate diagnosis to understand if the issue is structural or related to ventilation.

  • Insurance Support: We provide a certified technical report to facilitate reimbursement procedures with your home insurance ("Detection and Restoration" clause).

The advantages of the Marenetto Build method

Being a General Contractor, we can offer you a turnkey service. After locating the leak with a geophone or thermal camera, we can proceed directly with repair and building restoration, coordinating all necessary tradespeople.

  • Targeted intervention: We break only where needed (often just one tile).

  • Speed: Complete diagnosis within hours.

  • calibrated equipment and technicians experienced in construction.

🚒 Need an urgent infiltration search?

Don't let water damage your structure. Contact the Marenetto Build team now for a technical inspection with advanced equipment.

Today, doing construction work in Cefalù means not only building but also preserving the territory’s beauty through:

  • Sustainable Building: Using natural materials to ensure thermal comfort during Sicily’s hot summers.

  • Urban Redevelopment: Targeted interventions aimed at reclaiming existing volumes without further land consumption.

  • Seismic Upgrading: Essential for the long-term safety of both historic and modern buildings in the area.

Staying updated on the latest developments in local construction is vital for anyone looking to invest in one of Sicily's most prestigious locations.

FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions

How long does it take to renovate an apartment in Cefalù?

For a standard three-room apartment, average times range from 3 to 5 months. In the historic center, duration may be slightly longer due to time restrictions on material transport.

Can I benefit from tax deductions in 2026?

Certainly yes. We continuously monitor regulatory changes to ensure you access renovation and energy-saving tax incentives available this year.

Do you dream of a seaside villa or an apartment in the heart of Cefalù’s historic center?

Purchasing a property in this gem of the Tyrrhenian is an extraordinary investment, but the beauty of Sicily's landscape hides unique technical and bureaucratic challenges.

Before signing any preliminary agreement, it’s essential to know what to check to prevent your dream from turning into an endless construction site. In this guide, the experts at Marenetto Build reveal the 5 critical points to verify for a renovation without surprises.


1. Verify Urban Planning and Land Registry Compliance

In Sicily, especially in historic villages, discrepancies between the actual state and registered floor plans are not uncommon.

  • What to check: Is there a building permit? Are there verandas or closures that have not been legalized?

  • The technician's advice: A land registry discrepancy can block your mortgage or prevent you from accessing the 2026 Building Bonuses. Always request Access to Documents at the Municipality.

2. Structural Condition Analysis: Cracks and Floors

The historic houses in Cefalù are often built with load-bearing masonry or stone.

  • Warning signs: 45-degree cracks near openings or floors showing noticeable sagging.

  • Solution: Before purchasing, an inspection with a thermal camera can reveal structural issues invisible to the naked eye, allowing you to negotiate the sale price accordingly.

3. Rising Damp and Salt Damage

The marine climate is wonderful for us but harsh on buildings. Salt corrodes reinforced concrete rebar (carbonation), and moisture rises from foundations.

  • What to look for: Plaster detachment at wall bases or salt efflorescence stains.

  • Marenetto Solution: We assess using dehumidifying plasters or chemical barriers to ensure your renovation lasts over time.

4. Landscape and Heritage Restrictions

A large part of Cefalù’s territory is subject to landscape restrictions. This means you cannot change facade colors or window types without authorization.

  • The risk: Long bureaucratic delays and hefty fines.

  • The advantage of a General Contractor: Relying on someone already familiar with local regulations significantly speeds up the permit process.

5. Energy Efficiency: Climate Control Respecting Tradition

Heating and cooling a stone house requires smart solutions.

  • Innovation: Consider installing an internal thermal insulation system or invisible heat pump systems that won’t alter your new property’s exterior appearance.

Why Request a Pre-Purchase Consultation?

Many clients contact us after buying their property, discovering unexpected restoration costs. Our Cefalù pre-purchase consultation service offers you:

  1. An estimated bill of quantities for necessary works.

  2. An assessment of technical risks.

  3. The certainty of your design project’s feasibility.
